translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: K'ahaata Yara Gidiyaa Leewatuwaa Oosuwaa
Med'inaa Goday Musanne Aaroona hawaadan yaageedda;
«Leewiyaa zaratuwaan K'ahaata yaratuwaa unttunttu dabbuwaan dabbuwaaninne unttunttu soo asan asan shaakkaade payda;
yelettoodeppe laytsay hattamuwaappe biide ishatamuwaa gakkeedda attuma asaa ubbaa, S'oossaa Dunkkaaniyaa giddon ootsanaw yiyaawantta payda.
K'ahaata yaratuu S'oossaa Dunkkaaniyaa giddon ootsana oosuu hawaa: unttunttu ubbaappe aad'd'eeda geeshsha miishshatuwaan aawotiino.
«Asay dunkkaaneedda saappe baanaw haniyaa wode, Aarooninne Aa attuma naanay S'oossaa Dunkkaaniyaa giddo geliide, Taabootaa sintsa gaaridduwaa kak'uwaappe wotsino; he C'aak'uwaa Taabootaa aan kammino.
He kammeeddawaa bollakka wod'iyaa irbbaaniyaa kammino; hewaa bollakka k'ay gujjiide, saluwaa malatiyaa c'ark'k'iyaa kammino; tookkiyaa kasotuwaa unttunttu sagaayetuwaan aatsino.

«S'oossaa sintsa shiishshiyaa ukitsaa wotsiyaa s'arap'p'eezaa bollan saluwaa malatiyaa c'ark'k'iyaa hiis's'ino; Aa bolla saanetuwaa, c'ilppatuwaa, s'uu'atuwaanne ushshaa yarshshoo go'ettiyaa ototuwaa wotsino; k'ay ukitsay ubbaa wodekka Aa bollappe d'ayoppo.
Hewaa bollan zo'o c'ark'k'iyaa hiis's'iide, irbbaniyaa k'ay Aa bolla kammino; tookkiyaa kasotuwaa sagaayetuwaan aatsino.

«Unttunttu saluwaa malatiyaa c'ark'k'iyaa akkiide, s'omppiyaa wotsiyaa ballatuwaa s'omppetuwaanna, toyissiyaa k'ap'etuwaana, unttuntta wotsiyaabatuwaananne zayitiyaa tigiyaa s'aarotuwaanakka ubbaa kammino.
Yaatiide aakka miishshatuwaa ubbaakka irbbaniyan kammiide, tookkiyaa shanchchamaa bollan wotsino.
«Is'aanaa c'uwissiyaa work'k'aa saas'iniyaa bollan saluwaa malatiyaa c'ark'k'iyaa hiis's'eeddawaa k'ay irbbaniyan kammino; tookkiyaa kasotuwaa unttunttu sagaayetuwaan aatsino.
Hewaadankka, k'ay S'oossaa Dunkkaaniyaa giddon go'ettiyaa miishshatuwaa ubbaa akkiide, saluwaa malatiyaa c'ark'k'iyaan s'aas'ino; irbbaniyan kammiide, tookkiyaa shanchchamaa bollan wotsino.
«Yaatiide nahaasiyaappe ootseedda yarshshiyaa sa'aa bolla de'iyaa bidintsaa diggiide Aa bolla ochchaa teeraa malatiyaa c'ark'k'iyaa hiis's'ino.

Aa bolla yarshshiyaasan go'ettiyaa miishshatuwaa ubbaa, tamaa c'ooc'etuwaa, ashuwaa k'ap'iyaa k'ap'etuwaa, akaafatuwaanne kaashiyaa kuyis'aarotuwaa wotsino. Irbbaniyan kammino; tookkiyaa kasotuwaa unttunttu sagaayetuwaan aatsino.

«Aarooninne Aa attuma naanay, geeshshabatuwaanne geeshsha miishshatuwaa ubbaa kammiide makkooppenne dunkkaaneedda sa'aappe denddiyaa wodii gakkooppe, hewaa ubbaa tookkanaw K'ahaata yaratuu yiino. Shin geeshsha miishshatuwaa unttunttu bochchooppe hayk'k'ino. S'oossaa Dunkkaaniyaa giddon de'iyaa he miishshaa K'ahaata yaratuu tookkino.

«K'eesiyaa Aaroona na'ay El"aazari s'omppiyaa zayitiyaw, sawiyaa is'aanaw, hachchi hachchi yarshshiyaa katsaa yarshshuwaanne okkiyaa zayitiyaw, k'ay S'oossaa Dunkkaaniyaa muliyaanne Aa giddon de'iyaa dumma geeshsha miishshatuwaa ubbaa bolla aawoto» yaageedda.
K'ay Med'inaa Goday Musanne Aaroona hawaadan yaageedda;
«K'ahaata yaratuu Leewiyaa zaratuwaappe hayk'k'iide d'ayenna mala s'eellite.

Ubbaappe aad'd'eedda geeshsha miishshaa mata shiik'iyaa wode, unttunttu hayk'k'ennan pas'a attiide de'ana mala, unttunttoo hawaadan ootsite: Aarooninne Aa attuma naanay S'oossaa Dunkkaaniyaa giddo geliide K'ahaata yaratuu ubbay huup'iyaan huup'iyaan ootsana oosuwaanne tookkana tookuwaa shaakki shaakkiide gishino.
K'ahaata yaratuu hayk'k'ennaadan, ubbaappe aad'd'iyaa geeshshatuwaa k'eesatuu s'aas'ishin be'anaw gidduwaa geloppino» yaageedda.
Gershshoona Yara Gidiyaa Leewatuwaa Oosuwaa
Med'inaa Goday Musa hawaadan yaageedda;
«Gershshoona yaratuwaakka unttunttu dabbuwaan dabbuwaaninne unttunttu soo asan asan shaakkaade payda;
yelettoodeppe laytsay hattamuwaappe biide ishatamuwaa gakkeedda attuma asaa ubbaa, S'oossaa Dunkkaaniyaa giddon ootsanaw yiyaawantta payda.
«Gershshoona yaratuu ootsiyaa oosuunne tookkiyaa tookku hawaa:
unttunttu S'oossaa Dunkkaaniyaa gaariddotuwaa, S'oossaa Dunkkaaniyaa, Aa kammiyaabatuwaanne bollana kammiyaa irbbaniyaa, S'oossaa Dunkkaaniyaa geliyaasan sottiyaa gaaridduwaa tookkino;

k'ay S'oossaa Dunkkaaniyaanne yarshshiyaa sa'aa yuuyyi aad'd'eeda dabaabaa gaariddotuwaa, dabaabaa geliyaasaa gaaridduwaa, wodorotuwaanne unttunttoo go"iya miishshatuwaa ubbaa tookkino. Gershshoona yaratuu ha miishshatuwaan ootsanaw bessiyaa oosuwaa ubbaa ootsino.

Tookkiyaawaa gidina, hara oosuwaa gidinakka unttunttu ootsiyaa oosuwaa ubbay Aarooninne Aa attuma naanay unttuntta azazina oosettino. Neeni unttunttu tookkanaw bessiyaabatuwaa ubbaa unttunttu aawotetsaa aawotetsaadan unttunttoo gisha.
S'oossaa Dunkkaaniyaa giddon Gershshoona yaratuu ootsana oosuu ubbay hawaa. Unttunttu ootsana oosuwaa ubbay k'eesiyaa Aaroona na'aa Itaamaara aawotetsaa garssaana gidanawaa.
Maraara Yara Gidiyaa Leewatuwaa Oosuwaa
«Maraara yaratuwaa unttunttu dabbuwaan dabbuwaaninne unttunttu soo asan asan shaakkaade payda;
yelettoodeppe laytsay hattamuwaappe biide ishatamuwaa gakkeedda attuma asaa ubbaa, S'oossaa Dunkkaaniyaa giddon ootsanaw yiyaawantta payda.
«Unttunttu S'oossaa Dunkkaaniyaa giddon ootsana oosotuu hawantta: unttuntta Dunkkaaniyaa s'agaagetuwaa, kulbbotuwaa, tuussatuwaanne gedetuwaa,

k'aykka dabaabaa yuushshuwaan ek'k'iyaa tuussatuwaa, he tuussatuu gedetuwaa, toliyaa s'agaagetuwaa, wodorotuwaa, hewanttoo koshshiyaa miishshatuwaa ubbaanne he miishshatuwaanna gaketiyaabatuwaa ubbaa tookkino. Itti itti uraw I tookkanawaa shaakkaade gisha.
S'oossaa Dunkkaaniyaa giddon Maraara yaratuu ootsana oosuu ubbaanna hawaa. Unttunttu ootsana ooso ubbay k'eesiyaa Aaroona na'aa Itaamaara aawotetsaa garssaana gidanawaa» yaageedda.
Leewatuwaa Payduwaabaa
Muse Aarooninne maabaraa kaappatuu K'ahaata yaratuwaa attuma asaa unttunttu dabbuwaan dabbuwaaninne unttunttu soo asan asan shaakkiide paydeeddino.
Yelettoodeppe laytsay hattamuwaappe biide ishatamuwaa gakkeedda attuma asatuu ubbatuu, S'oossaa Dunkkaaniyaa giddon ootsanaw yiyaawanttu,
unttunttu soo asan asan paydina ubbaanna 2,750.
K'ahaata yaratuwaan S'oossaa Dunkkaaniyaa giddon ootseedda asaa paydu hawaa. Med'inaa Goday Muse baggana azazeeddawaadan, Musenne Aarooni unttuntta paydeeddino.
Gershshoona yaratuukka barenttu dabbuwaan dabbuwaaninne barenttu soo asan asan shaakettiide paydeteeddino.
Yelettoodeppe laytsay hattamuwaappe biide ishatamuwaa gakkeedda attuma asatuu ubbatuu, S'oossaa Dunkkaaniyaa giddon ootsanaw yiyaawanttu,
unttunttu soo asan asan paydina ubbay 2,630.
Gershshoona yaratuwaan S'oossaa Dunkkaaniyaa giddon ootseedda asaa paydina hawaa. Med'inaa Goday Muse baggana azazeeddawaadan, Musenne Aarooni unttuntta paydeeddino.
Maraara yaratuukka k'ay dabbuwaan dabbuwaaninne barenttu soo asan asan shaakettiide paydeteeddino.
Yelettoodeppe laytsay hattamuwaappe biide ishatamuwaa gakkeedda attuma asatuu ubbatuu, S'oossaa Dunkkaaniyaa giddon ootsanaw yiyaawanttu,
unttunttu soo asan asan paydina ubbay 3,200.
Maraara yaratuwaa paydu hawaa. Med'inaa Goday Muse baggana azazeeddawaadan, Musenne Aarooni unttuntta paydeeddino.
Hewaa ootsiide Muse, Aarooninne Israa'eeliyaa kaappatuu Leewatuwaa ubbaa, unttunttu yaran yaraaninne unttunttu soo asan asan shaakkiide paydeeddino.
Yelettoodeppe laytsay hattamuwaappe biide ishatamuwaa gakkeedda attuma asatuu ubbatuu, S'oossaa Dunkkaaniyaa giddon oosuwaa ootsanawunne aw go"iya miishshatuwaa ubbaa tookkanaw yeeddawanttu
ubbay 8,580.

Med'inaa Goday Muse baggana azazeeddawaadan, unttunttu huup'iyaan huup'iyaan ootsana oosuu woy tookkana tookuukka unttunttoo odetteedda. Med'inaa Goday Musa azazeeddawaadan, unttunttu ubbaykka paydeteeddino.
